notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only status is the undated Wikipedia list entry 'Still standing.' (its Street View note is not a dated check). The Central US Lookouts page lists the name only. No build date, builder, height, owner or access rules were found. Sunny Hill does not appear in the cached NHLR Louisiana index or the cached FFLOS pages we searched. anyplaceamerica.com and mindat.org refused fetches (HTTP 403), so their tower pages were not read. Access level left unset. Suggest asking the Louisiana Department of Agriculture and Forestry (Office of Forestry) and checking a recent photo before any change to status.
